method: Same stable real-app viewport before and after replacing .animated-value with its final live textNode; reduced motion, no hover. Assert exact RGBA inside each numeric rectangle plus2px and exact text/parent geometry. Report other viewport pixels separately without asserting them.
limitations: Final number pixels and geometry only; does not claim the whole viewport is identical, or measure count performance/intermediate widths. Offscreen number pixels are not tested, but their text and parent geometry is checked.
